known_issue.description: A continuous slice of a country/ASN-sorted task list caused successful measurements to cluster in three RU ASNs; KZ/BY probes were not adequately represented. The first-run reachability totals are exploratory only.
known_issue.required_fix: Implemented: round-robin per-provider complete four-task bundles; rotate provider/target choice by UTC date; do not split bundles when budget is short. CI run 42859374441 failed only because the earlier test asserted partial bundle output; expectation and scheduler were corrected.
